2.description: Sickness or Injury: You are injured or become sick.

3.description: Birth or Death: Someone close to you dies or is born. You are involved in some fashion (e.g., parent, godparent, etc.).

4.description: Ending of Relationship: A romantic relationship ends badly.

5.description: Improved Relationship: A romantic relationship deepens, possibly leading to marriage.

6.description: New Relationship: You become involved in a romantic relationship.

7.description: New Contact: You gain a new Contact.

8.description: Betrayal: You are betrayed by a friend.

9.description: Travel: You move to another world.

10.description: Good Fortune: You come into money, fulfill a dream, or experience a great event.

11.description: Crime: You are involved in a crime, as victim, perpetrator, or accused.

12.description: Unusual Event: Something strange happens. Roll 1D for effect.

1.description: Psionics: You encounter a Psionic institute.

2.description: Aliens: You spend time among an alien species.

3.description: Alien Artefact: You possess a strange device of alien origin.

4.description: Amnesia: Something happened, but you do not know what.

5.description: Contact with Government: You briefly meet the highest levels of Imperial society.

6.description: Ancient Technology: You have something older than the Imperium.
